basic_details.short_information: Software Technology Parks of India (STPI) Junior Hindi Translator Recruitment 2026 Notification has been released on 25-07-2026 on the official website www.stpi.in. A total of 9 vacancies have been announced through the STPI Junior Hindi Translator Recruitment 2026.

application_fee.details: The mode and process of fee payment will be specified on the online application portal. Application fee once paid will not be refunded under any circumstances.

age_limit.details: The maximum age limit for appointment on direct recruitment basis is 30 years. Age is reckoned as on the last date of receipt of online applications, i.e., 07.09.2026.

qualification.details: Candidates must meet the following essential qualification requirements (any one of the following combinations) as specified in the official notification, applicable for Direct Recruits: | Master's degree from a recognized University in Hindi with English as a compulsory or elective subject, or as the medium of examination at degree level; OR Master's degree from a recognized University in English with Hindi as a compulsory or elective subject, or as the medium of examination at degree level; OR Master's degree in any subject other than Hindi or English, with Hindi as medium and English as a compulsory/elective subject at degree level; OR Master's degree in any subject other than Hindi or English, with English as medium and Hindi as a compulsory/elective subject at degree level; OR Master's degree in any subject other than Hindi or English, with Hindi and English as compulsory/elective subjects or either as medium of examination and the other as a compulsory/elective subject at degree level. | AND, in addition to the above, candidates must also possess: | A recognized Diploma or Certificate Course in translation from Hindi to English and vice-versa, OR Two years' experience of translation work from Hindi to English and vice-versa in a Central Government or State Government office, including a Government of India Undertaking.

salary_details.details: The post of Junior Hindi Translator carries Pay Matrix Level 6 (Rs. 35,400 - 112,400) as per the 7th Central Pay Commission. The appointment will initially be on probation for a period of two years, which may be regularized, extended, or terminated based on performance during the probation period.

Locate the online application link for Employment Notice No. 2(1)/I/STPI-HQ/2026-27.
Register and fill in the online application form carefully, ensuring all essential steps are completed.
Upload the required scanned documents and category/qualification certificates as applicable.
Pay the applicable application fee (if not exempted) through the mode specified on the portal.
Submit the application before the last date, i.e., 07.09.2026 (23:00 hours).
Save/download the confirmation page for future reference.

Any such case detected at any stage may lead to cancellation of candidature or termination of service, even after appointment. No correspondence will be entertained regarding the selection/test/interview/appointment process. Canvassing in any form will lead to disqualification. Candidates seeking reservation or age relaxation must submit the requisite certificates in the prescribed Central Government format; certificates in any other format are liable to be rejected. Candidature will remain provisional until verification of educational, caste/category, and other certificates by the Appointing Authority. content_sections.heading: STPI Junior Hindi Translator Recruitment 2026 Notification PDF
content_sections.text: The Software Technology Parks of India (STPI), an autonomous society under the Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology (MeitY), Government of India, has officially released Employment Notice No. 2(1)/I/STPI-HQ/2026-27 for the recruitment of 9 Junior Hindi Translator (JHT) posts through Direct Recruitment. The notification provides complete details regarding vacancy distribution, educational qualifications, age limit, pay scale, application fee, selection process, examination pattern, examination centres, required documents, important instructions, and the online application process. Eligible candidates are advised to read the official notification carefully before submitting their online application. The notification is available on the official STPI website. content_sections.heading: STPI Junior Hindi Translator Recruitment 2026 Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Candidates must meet the following essential qualification requirements (any one of the following combinations) as specified in the official notification, applicable for Direct Recruits: Master's degree from a recognized University in Hindi with English as a compulsory or elective subject, or as the medium of examination at degree level; OR Master's degree from a recognized University in English with Hindi as a compulsory or elective subject, or as the medium of examination at degree level; OR Master's degree in any subject other than Hindi or English, with Hindi as medium and English as a compulsory/elective subject at degree level; OR Master's degree in any subject other than Hindi or English, with English as medium and Hindi as a compulsory/elective subject at degree level; OR Master's degree in any subject other than Hindi or English, with Hindi and English as compulsory/elective subjects or either as medium of examination and the other as a compulsory/elective subject at degree level. AND , in addition to the above, candidates must also possess: A recognized Diploma or Certificate Course in translation from Hindi to English and vice-versa, OR Two years' experience of translation work from Hindi to English and vice-versa in a Central Government or State Government office, including a Government of India Undertaking.

content_sections.heading: STPI Junior Hindi Translator Age Limit 2026
content_sections.text: The maximum age limit for appointment on direct recruitment basis is 30 years . Age is reckoned as on the last date of receipt of online applications, i.e., 07.09.2026.

rows.age_relaxation: Up to 5 years, as per Central Government instructions/orders
As per prevailing Government of India instructions (relaxable as applicable)

content_sections.heading: STPI Junior Hindi Translator 2026 Salary Structure
content_sections.text: The post of Junior Hindi Translator carries Pay Matrix Level 6 (Rs. 35,400 - 112,400) as per the 7th Central Pay Commission. The appointment will initially be on probation for a period of two years, which may be regularized, extended, or terminated based on performance during the probation period.

content_sections.heading: STPI Recruitment 2026 Application Fee
content_sections.text: The mode and process of fee payment will be specified on the online application portal. Application fee once paid will not be refunded under any circumstances.

content_sections.heading: STPI Junior Hindi Translator Recruitment 2026 Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selection for the JHT post will be based on a written examination consisting of two papers: Paper-I consists of objective-type multiple-choice questions testing understanding of Hindi and English language and literature, correct usage of words, phrases, and idioms. There is a negative marking of 0.25 marks for each wrong answer in Paper-I. Based on marks scored in Paper-I, candidates will be shortlisted category-wise for Paper-II. Paper-II includes one passage for translation from Hindi to English, one passage from English to Hindi, and an essay each in Hindi and English. For final selection, weightage will be 50% of the scores in Paper-I and 100% of the marks in Paper-II. There may be separate category-wise cut-offs for Paper-I and Paper-II. Minimum marks required for final selection/merit are as follows: In case of a tie in aggregate marks, resolution will follow this order: (1) marks in Paper-II, (2) date of birth (older candidates placed higher), (3) alphabetical order of candidates' names.

content_sections.text: The examination for the Junior Hindi Translator post will be conducted at Delhi/NCR and Bengaluru locations.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for STPI Junior Hindi Translator Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application is 07.09.2026 up to 23:00 hours.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in STPI Junior Hindi Translator Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 9 vacancies (UR-6, OBC-2, SC-1).

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for STPI JHT Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit is 30 years as on the last date of receipt of online applications, with relaxation of up to 5 years for Government servants as per Central Government instructions.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary of Junior Hindi Translator in STPI?
faq.answer: The post carries Pay Matrix Level 6 (Rs. 35,400 - 112,400).

faq.question: Q5. What is the application fee for STPI Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The application fee is Rs. 500/-. No fee is required for female candidates and candidates belonging to SC/ST/PH categories.

faq.question: Q6. What is the selection process for STPI Junior Hindi Translator post?
faq.answer: Selection is based on a written examination comprising Paper-I (Objective Type - General Hindi and General English) and Paper-II (Descriptive - Translation and Essay). Final merit is based on 50% weightage of Paper-I and 100% of Paper-II marks.

faq.question: Q7. Where will the STPI JHT exam be conducted?
faq.answer: The examination will be conducted at Delhi/NCR and Bengaluru centres.

faq.question: Q8. Is there negative marking in the STPI JHT exam?
faq.answer: Yes, there is a negative marking of 0.25 marks for each wrong answer in Paper-I.

faq.question: Q9. What is the mode of application for STPI Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Applications must be submitted online only through www.stpi.in. No other mode of application is accepted.

faq.question: Q10. What is the educational qualification required for STPI Junior Hindi Translator post?
faq.answer: A Master's degree in Hindi/English (with specific subject/medium combinations as detailed in the notification) along with a recognized Diploma/Certificate in translation or two years' translation experience in a Central/State Government office.
